time_basis: Elapsed forecast hours from 2026-09-04 20:00 America/New_York (EDT, UTC-04:00)
assumptions: The user selected September 4 as the forecast start; 20:00 EDT is the planning reference. Actual kickoff still requires owners, accounts, machines and working capacity.
The forecast assumes three full lead teams with disjoint writers, prompt reviews, and 2-4 hour integration checkpoints.
Start and end hours are planning offsets, not commitments or evidence that work is unimplemented, active, or complete.
Concrete task dependencies are finish-to-start. Phase-epic dependencies are completion gates while independent child preparation may overlap.
Buzz offsets represent remaining runtime validation and receipts from the current pilot state; final distributed-build acceptance stays with the release-owning session.

acceptance_buffer.purpose: Reserved for discovered defects, native-environment issues, final distributed-build receipts, and acceptance reruns.

confidence_scale.high: The sequence is largely procedural and uses already-defined inputs.
confidence_scale.medium: The sequence is plausible with the assumed teams and prompt owner decisions.
confidence_scale.low: Native, cross-machine, broad migration, or integrated acceptance variance can move the finish.

critical_path.parallel_convergence: R00 -> R03 also converges at R05; R14 -> R15 constrains R18 coordination acceptance but does not block R18.1 document work.
critical_path.risk: The path is dominated by authoritative document migration and downstream editor/platform validation; delayed owner decisions, native machines, or integration repair consume the H240-H336 buffer.

preparation_overlaps.overlap: Starts at H2 before F0 rolls up at H8 because R01/R05 preparation does not depend on conditional R04 native packaging acceptance.
Starts at H7 before F1 rolls up at H12 because R08/R09 have their concrete prerequisites while R07 continues independently.
Starts at H16 before all F2 work ends at H18 because R13 does not depend on the R10 native feasibility lane.
Rollup starts with R18.1 at H20; R18 coordination cannot be accepted until R15 ends at H36, while the document family has already satisfied its own dependencies.
R19 measurement starts at H16 from R03/R12 and continues through migration; final F5 acceptance still waits for R20/R21.

F0.rationale: Rolls up R00/R02/R03 and conditional R04 baseline work.

F1.rationale: Rolls up portable rules, module gates, isolation, and CI preparation; independent prep overlaps F0.

F2.rationale: Rolls up extraction, contracts, commands, diagnostics, and native feasibility after their task prerequisites.

F3.rationale: Initial property and MCP proof reach H24; gesture, color, and real native effect continue afterward.

F4.rationale: Rolls up the six R18 families as accepted interfaces make each family ready.

F5.rationale: Continuous measurement begins early; recovery and packaged validation finish after migrations converge.

F6.rationale: R22 targets H240; the phase remains open through the explicit H240-H336 acceptance buffer.

R00.rationale: Resolve current source, active work, ownership decisions, and collisions before dependent tasks.

R01.rationale: Begins after R00 and BZ0 establish the current authority contract.

R02.rationale: Baseline commands and receipts proceed immediately after the source is selected.

R03.rationale: Surface inventory and initial fixtures run in parallel with baseline command work.

R04.rationale: Conditional slot for a blocker reproduced by R02; non-reproduction yields evidence rather than repair work.

R05.rationale: Portable rules and the surface inventory provide the inputs for enforceable profiles.

R06.rationale: Starts when R02 has named commands and source/build identities to isolate.

R07.rationale: CI gates start after commands, module checks, and isolation are executable.

R08.rationale: The characterized surface, profiles, and isolated runner allow a bounded extraction trial.

R09.rationale: Foundational contracts start when rules, inventory, and architecture gates converge.

R10.rationale: Native feasibility waits for R04 evidence and R09 image/parameter contracts.

R11.rationale: Dispatcher and history work begins after the ownership contracts land.

R12.rationale: Deterministic diagnostics require isolation, contracts, and a real command/history path.

R13.rationale: The first property slice starts after extraction, commands, and replay diagnostics finish.

R14.rationale: Initial Rust MCP and two-client proof consumes the completed property and shared services.

R15.rationale: The second command shape follows accepted property and MCP seams.

R16.rationale: Real effect integration starts after feasibility, property/MCP, and R17 color contracts; full plugin proof is post-H24.

R17.rationale: Color, precision, EXR, and OTIO proof begins after R09 and R10 and lands before R16.

R18.rationale: Rolls up R18.1-R18.6; H20-H36 is justified family prep before the R15 coordination acceptance dependency clears.

R18.1.rationale: Document migration can begin after R09/R11/R13 without waiting for unrelated gesture or native-effect work.

R18.2.rationale: Animation/timeline migration waits for the document identity/history family.

R18.3.rationale: Renderer migration runs beside R18.2 after document and color prerequisites land.

R18.4.rationale: Editor tools follow gesture, document, and animation/timeline foundations.

R18.5.rationale: Media/export/native adapters follow the real effect, color, document, and renderer families.

R18.6.rationale: Preferences, dynamic controls, diagnostics, and Labs follow the migrated editor-control family.

R19.rationale: Measurement starts from R03/R12 and expands continuously as migration candidates integrate.

R20.rationale: Full recovery/fault acceptance starts when all named migration-family dependencies finish.

R21.rationale: Packaged/browser/OS validation follows native, media, performance, and recovery evidence.

R22.rationale: Inventory reconciliation and maintainer acceptance target day 10 after all explicit predecessors finish.

BZ0.rationale: Confirm the current collaboration authority and continuity contract at kickoff.

BZ1.rationale: Remaining desktop onboarding and owner-backed agent checks follow BZ0.

BZ2.rationale: Verify the existing Nemo Project/repository binding and automatic workspace access after BZ0.

BZ3.rationale: Run remaining lifecycle, reconnect, handoff, cancellation, and revocation acceptance after onboarding/binding evidence.

BZ4.rationale: GitHub link validation waits for BZ3 and executable R07 gates.

BZ5.rationale: CI and product-MCP receipt linking follows BZ3, R07, R12, and the H24 R14 proof.

BZ6.rationale: Remaining backup/restore, upgrades, monitoring, support, and offboarding receipts run through the integrated-build period.
